name: Masterplan Zoning Agent
tagline: Draw a site boundary and get a zoned, code-compliant masterplan with a road network.
description: Generates a colour-coded zoning and land-use plan from a drawn site boundary and zone-mix targets, runs a site-intelligence pass (adjacent roads, entry/access, sun, wind, terrain, noise), lays out an internal road network by width hierarchy, and reports per-parcel code compliance against NBC 2016 (FAR, ground coverage, height, parking).

page.objective: Turn a raw site boundary into a coded, compliant zoning plan without laying out parcels by hand.
page.problem: Building a zoning plan and checking every parcel against code (FAR, coverage, height, parking) is normally a slow, parcel-by-parcel manual exercise.
page.solution: A drawn boundary and zone-mix target auto-generate a zoning plan and road network, and every parcel carries its own live NBC 2016 compliance check.

highlights.headline: Blank site to a coloured, area-quantified, code-checked zoning plan.
points: Draw site, set zone mix — choose a layout strategy (Grid, Organic, Radial, Spine & Branch) against zone-mix targets.
Live site intelligence — automatic read of adjacent roads, entry/access, sun, wind, terrain, and noise.
Auto-generated zoning plan — labelled, area-quantified land-use parcels from a blank site.
Per-parcel code compliance — click any parcel for its FAR, ground coverage, height, and parking check against NBC 2016.
